candidates.text:
FR-1 Secure Auth Authentication using system credentials; passwords hashed with Argon2. 1 Critical (5%)
[Acceptance Criteria] • FR-1: Users can register/login; password storage verified as Argon2; admin can assign roles. Unit tests cover login and role checks.

FR-2 Conflict Check Rejects appointment booking if the doctor is busy in the requested slot. 1 High (10%)
[Acceptance Criteria] • FR-2: Attempting to book overlapping appointments for the same doctor returns a conflict error; implemented by a temporal-overlap check (i.e., start time < existing end AND end time > existing start) and covered by integration tests.

FR-3 EHR Hub Digital registration and retrieval of patient profiles and history. 1 High (15%)
[Acceptance Criteria] • FR-3: Create/update/view patient profile operations persist changes and display visit history; API tests included.

FR-4 Auto- Billing System calculates total bill including services and 18% GST. 2 Medium (20%)
[Acceptance Criteria] • FR-4: Invoice total = sum(items) + 18% GST; exported PDF matches template.

FR-5 Audit Log Automated tracking of all record deletions and administrative changes. 2 Medium (10%)
[Acceptance Criteria] • FR-5: Any DELETE/UPDATE on sensitive records creates an audit entry with actor and timestamp.

FR-6 AI Help Desk AI-powered assistant using NLP-based FAQ and Retrieval- Augmented Generation (RAG) to answer system-related queries. 4 Low (30%)
[Acceptance Criteria] • FR-6: AI helpdesk responds with contextual answers (MVP: canned responses + FAQ), logs queries for review. 4

skipped_sections.heading: 1.1 Purpose
items: This document outlines the detailed specifications for ProClinic, a unified Electronic Health Record (EHR) platform for clinical management, appointment tracking, and billing.

skipped_sections.heading: 1.2 Scope
items: Manage Electronic Health Records (EHR) for patients.
Conflict-aware appointment scheduling for doctors.
Digital prescription generation with medicine tracking.
Automated, GST-compliant hospital billing.
Role-based dashboards for specific user classes.

skipped_sections.heading: 1.3 Intended Audience
items: The intended audience includes the project supervisor, development team, and university evaluators.

skipped_sections.heading: 1.4 Glossary of Terms
items: EHR Electronic Health Record - Digital version of a patient’s medical history. RBAC Role-Based Access Control - Authorization based on user roles. Argon2 A memory-hard password hashing algorithm used for secure storage. JWT JSON Web Token - Used for secure, stateless API authentication.

skipped_sections.heading: 2.2 Architecture Overview
items: The system follows a modular 3-tier architecture:
Frontend: Django Templates / Bootstrap 5.
Backend: Python Django REST Framework (DRF).
Database: SQLite (Dev); PostgreSQL (Production).
DevOps: Dockerized services for consistent deployment.

skipped_sections.heading: 2.3 Future Enhancements
items: AI-based disease risk prediction and clinical decision support.
Voice-command patient record retrieval and voice notes for clinicians.
Integration with pharmacy inventory and third-party lab systems.
Mobile applications for patient-facing features and clinician on-the-go access.
Telemedicine/video-consultation module.

skipped_sections.heading: 4 Project Plan
items: Project Duration: Approximately 8 weeks.
Methodology: Agile (Scrum-based with 1-week sprints).
Tools: GitHub (repo + issues), Figma (UI design), Docker (local deployment), Postman (API testing).
Week 1: Requirement Analysis & SRS Finalization.
Week 2: Database Design and ER Mapping.
Week 3-4: Backend Logic & API Tier Development.
Week 5-6: Frontend Template & Dashboard Integration.
Week 7: Testing, Bug Fixing, & Security Review.
Week 8: Docker-based Deployment.
